sentences.en: The primates include not only the apes, but also man.
sentences.zh: 灵长类不仅包括猿，还包括人类。

sentences.en: Humans are not descended from apes, except for some people.
sentences.zh: 人类并非源自猿类，除非是某些人这么说。

sentences.en: Why have the apes evolved more than other animals?
sentences.zh: 为什么猿类比其他动物进化得更多？
